ev.q: A May 2020 survey of 1,933 practices participating in the Vaccines for Children program found that 1,727 (89.8%) were currently open
Practices in the Northeast were more likely to be closed (65, 15.0%) than were those in the South (42, 6.2%) and West (41, 10.0%).
1,727 (89.8%) were currently open; 1,397 (81.1%) of these reported offering immunization services to all of their patients.
1,135 (59.1%) were likely able to provide immunization services to new pediatric patients if necessary
urban practices and those in the Northeast were less likely to be able to accommodate new patients
a survey of practices participating in the Vaccines for Children (VFC) program was conducted during May 12–20, 2020.

methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to account for the sampling design; thus, all percentages reported are weighted.
statistical comparisons were made using chi-squared tests; a p-value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant.
were randomly sampled, with probability of selection proportional to the number of federally purchased vaccine doses shipped to the practice.
